book.name: 2 MAKOLINTE
book.title: Elin̄olo lya Paulusi no wiili ku MAKOLINTE

content: Okuba no Asikupumena
Abange, kame tusinga nji mulimuke esishemo sa Nyambe eso sina monisiwa mu tikeleke namu Mesodoniya.
Kakuli mu kwetekiwa onene no mayando, okuwabelelwa koo no kupula ni kusheba koo kame ana tundisa oufumu mu kuba koo.
Kakuli kame anabi okukumanena nomo ana kutweseta, kanyi aba nitwesa okupaka mane ni kubitelela omo ana kutweseta mu kusinga koo,
kame ana tukumbele mu ku tundamena onene nji twa lumelele okwingena mu tuso eyi itendelwa aanu a Nyambe no kukena.
Kame ana tende okubita esi tuna kusepa, kakuli kame ana tangisa oweli oukubeeka kunji wa Mbumu ni kunji wetu mu kusinga kwa Nyambe.
Kame tuna kumbela Tite woyo ona kutateka omusebezi oweli, nji afanene oku umanenena ngeso mukaci kenu owo musebezi no sishemo.
Cwale kanyi aba muna pulelwe mu inu yonje, mu tumelo, mu kwamba, mu zibo, mu niti yonje mane ni mu lilato lyenu mulibaka lyetu, mu mone nji mupulelwe ni mu musebezi no utokwa.
Ka naamba eyi kanyi etaelo. Kono mukulimuka mulibaka no niti no yenu nji elilato lyenu no niti ngeso.
Kakuli kame muyii esishemo sa Mbumu wetu Jesu Kilesite nji naaba ana kufuma, cwale mulibaka lyenu natende osikusheba nji cwale mukusheba kwaye mufanene okufuma.
Cwale mu taba eyi kame niba ekelezo yange nji kwa kuwaba aanyi cwale okumanenena eyo munaku tateka mwakuyu kasa mu kutenda fela kono muku lakaza,
cwale nji okutukiseta kwenu mu kulakza kufanene okwendelela ni kumanenena kwenu kweyo mu kwite.
Kakuli nji okutukiseta kwakuli kame kulumelelwe okukumanena kweso akwite omunu, kasa okukumanena kweso aulwile omunu.
Kani talusa nji anjili atusiwe mi anyi muimelwe,
kono ku tendwe mu kufanenena eyo mukwite ba nako ino mufanene okwekeza eyo asinga, nji cwale eyo akwite yekeze eyo musinga nji cwale kufanenene.
Kanyi omo kun̄olelwe nji, “Woyo ona ungeke onene kasi siyalelwa esinjili mi woyo ona ungeke mbicani alese okuulwa.”
Tite ni Sikwata saye
Kono kame tukutumela kwa Nyambe woyo ona beeke epabalelo inene mulibaka lyenu mu mucima wa Tite.
Kakuli katambula fela oku kumbela kwetu, kono mu koongola kwaye onene kame ata ni kwaanyi mu kusinga kwaye.
Bamweya ni yonyene kame tu tuma omwabetu, woyo olimukiwa onene elibubo lyaye mu tikeleke tonje muku kutaza eliywi no kuwaba.
Mane kasa eyo fela, kono naku ketiwa ku tikeleke nji aende naaci mu musebezi waye no sishemo owo tu shimbile mulibaka no kanya ya Mbumu ni kumonisa okusinga kwetu no kuwaba.
Tu tende ngeso nji kuulwe omunu woyo sotunyaza mulibaka no tuso no mpo eyi, eyo twendisa.
Kakuli kame tusinga okutenda wino, kasa mu miyo a Mbumu fela, kono ni mu miyo no aanu ngeso.
Natu tumu omwabetu bamweya nonyene woyo tuna eteke aka no kupula ni kuwana eniti yaye mu titaba no kupula. Kono kame alakaza onene bano ni kubitelela mulibaka noku misepa onene.
Kakuli Tite kame atendile omulikani wange mane niku sebeza naye mu misebezi yenu, mi kwaabetu kame ali atumiwa no tikeleke ekanya ya Kilesite.
Cwale mu monise balubala no tikeleke oupaki no lilato lyenu mane ni ukuyeema kwetu mulibaka lyenu kwaanu aa.
